 36class _MgcvSplineTerm(_MgcvTerm):
 37    """Univariate smooth term s(x, bs='tp', k=10)."""
 38
 39    def __init__(
 40        self,
 41        feature: int,
 42        k: int = 10,
 43        bs: str = "tp",
 44        sp: Optional[float] = None,
 45        m: Optional[Union[int, Tuple[int, int]]] = None,
 46        knots: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
 47        constraint: Optional[str] = None,
 48    ) -> None:
 49        super().__init__()
 50        self.feature = int(feature)
 51        self.k = int(k)
 52        self.bs = bs.lower()
 53        if constraint == "periodic" and self.bs == "tp":
 54            self.bs = "cc"
 55        self.sp = [float(sp)] if sp is not None else None
 56        self.m = m
 57        self.knots = knots
 58        self._Z: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
 59        self._penalties: List[np.ndarray] = []
 60        self._meta: Dict[str, Any] = {}
 61        self.n_coefs = 0
 62
 63    def compile(self, x: np.ndarray) -> None:
 64        col = np.asarray(x[:, self.feature], dtype=float).ravel()
 65        X_raw, S_list, self._meta = build_smooth_basis(
 66            col, bs=self.bs, k=self.k, knots=self.knots, m=self.m
 67        )
 68        S_scaled, scales = rescale_penalty(X_raw, S_list)
 69        self._scales = scales
 70        X_abs, S_abs, self._Z = absorb_sum_to_zero_constraint(X_raw, S_scaled)
 71        self._penalties = S_abs
 72        self.n_coefs = X_abs.shape[1]
 73
 74    def build_columns(self, x: np.ndarray, is_training: bool = False) -> np.ndarray:
 75        col = np.asarray(x[:, self.feature], dtype=float).ravel()
 76        if self._Z is None:
 77            self.compile(x)
 78        X_raw = predict_smooth_basis(col, self._meta)
 79        return X_raw @ self._Z
 80
 81    def build_penalties(self) -> List[np.ndarray]:
 82        return [p.copy() for p in self._penalties]
 83
 84
 85class _MgcvTensorTerm(_MgcvTerm):
 86    """Tensor product smooth te(x1, x2, bs='cr', k=5)."""
 87
 88    def __init__(
 89        self,
 90        features: List[int],
 91        k: Union[int, List[int]] = 5,
 92        bs: Union[str, List[str]] = "cr",
 93        sp: Optional[Union[float, List[float]]] = None,
 94    ) -> None:
 95        super().__init__()
 96        self.features = [int(f) for f in features]
 97        self.d = len(self.features)
 98        if self.d < 2:
 99            raise ValueError("Tensor product term requires at least 2 features.")
100
101        if isinstance(k, int):
102            self.k_per = [k] * self.d
103        else:
104            self.k_per = [int(v) for v in k]
105
106        if isinstance(bs, str):
107            self.bs_per = [bs] * self.d
108        else:
109            self.bs_per = [str(v) for v in bs]
110
111        if sp is None:
112            self.sp = None
113        elif isinstance(sp, (int, float)):
114            self.sp = [float(sp)] * self.d
115        else:
116            self.sp = [float(v) for v in sp]
117
118        self._Z: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
119        self._penalties: List[np.ndarray] = []
120        self._marginal_meta: List[Dict] = []
121        self.n_coefs = 0
122
123    def compile(self, x: np.ndarray) -> None:
124        n = x.shape[0]
125        marg_X = []
126        marg_S = []
127        self._marginal_meta = []
128
129        for i, feat in enumerate(self.features):
130            col = np.asarray(x[:, feat], dtype=float).ravel()
131            Xi, Si, meta_i = build_smooth_basis(
132                col, bs=self.bs_per[i], k=self.k_per[i]
133            )
134            # Normalize marginal penalty by its largest eigenvalue as in mgcv
135            ev_max = np.linalg.eigvalsh(Si[0])[-1]
136            if ev_max > 0:
137                Si[0] = Si[0] / ev_max
138            marg_X.append(Xi)
139            marg_S.append(Si[0])
140            self._marginal_meta.append(meta_i)
141
142        # Row-wise tensor product
143        X_te = marg_X[0]
144        for i in range(1, self.d):
145            n_curr = X_te.shape[1]
146            n_next = marg_X[i].shape[1]
147            out = np.empty((n, n_curr * n_next), dtype=float)
148            col_idx = 0
149            for c1 in range(n_curr):
150                for c2 in range(n_next):
151                    out[:, col_idx] = X_te[:, c1] * marg_X[i][:, c2]
152                    col_idx += 1
153            X_te = out
154
155        # Tensor penalties
156        TS_list = []
157        sizes = [m.shape[1] for m in marg_X]
158        for i in range(self.d):
159            I_pre = np.eye(int(np.prod(sizes[:i])))
160            I_post = np.eye(int(np.prod(sizes[i + 1:])))
161            P_i = np.kron(np.kron(I_pre, marg_S[i]), I_post)
162            P_i = 0.5 * (P_i + P_i.T)
163            TS_list.append(P_i)
164
165        # Scale penalties and absorb sum-to-zero constraint
166        S_scaled, scales = rescale_penalty(X_te, TS_list)
167        self._scales = scales
168        X_abs, S_abs, self._Z = absorb_sum_to_zero_constraint(X_te, S_scaled)
169        self._penalties = S_abs
170        self.n_coefs = X_abs.shape[1]
171
172    def build_columns(self, x: np.ndarray, is_training: bool = False) -> np.ndarray:
173        if self._Z is None:
174            self.compile(x)
175        n = x.shape[0]
176        marg_X = []
177        for i, feat in enumerate(self.features):
178            col = np.asarray(x[:, feat], dtype=float).ravel()
179            Xi = predict_smooth_basis(col, self._marginal_meta[i])
180            marg_X.append(Xi)
181
182        X_te = marg_X[0]
183        for i in range(1, self.d):
184            n_curr = X_te.shape[1]
185            n_next = marg_X[i].shape[1]
186            out = np.empty((n, n_curr * n_next), dtype=float)
187            col_idx = 0
188            for c1 in range(n_curr):
189                for c2 in range(n_next):
190                    out[:, col_idx] = X_te[:, c1] * marg_X[i][:, c2]
191                    col_idx += 1
192            X_te = out
193
194        return X_te @ self._Z
195
196    def build_penalties(self) -> List[np.ndarray]:
197        return [p.copy() for p in self._penalties]
198
199
200class _MgcvFactorTerm(_MgcvTerm):
201    """Categorical factor term f(feature)."""
202
203    def __init__(
204        self,
205        feature: int,
206        coding: str = "dummy",
207    ) -> None:
208        super().__init__()
209        self.feature = int(feature)
210        self.coding = coding
211        self._levels: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
212        self.n_coefs = 0
213
214    def compile(self, x: np.ndarray) -> None:
215        col = np.asarray(x[:, self.feature]).ravel()
216        self._levels = np.unique(col)
217        # Dummy coding leaves out first level as reference
218        self.n_coefs = len(self._levels) - 1 if self.coding == "dummy" else len(self._levels)
219
220    def build_columns(self, x: np.ndarray, is_training: bool = False) -> np.ndarray:
221        col = np.asarray(x[:, self.feature]).ravel()
222        if self._levels is None:
223            self.compile(x)
224        B = (col[:, None] == self._levels[None, :]).astype(float)
225        if self.coding == "dummy":
226            B = B[:, 1:]
227        return B
228
229    def build_penalties(self) -> List[np.ndarray]:
230        # Unpenalized parametric factor in standard mgcv
231        return []
232
233
234class _MgcvLinearTerm(_MgcvTerm):
235    """Parametric linear term l(feature)."""
236
237    def __init__(self, feature: int) -> None:
238        super().__init__()
239        self.feature = int(feature)
240        self.n_coefs = 1
241
242    def compile(self, x: np.ndarray) -> None:
243        pass
244
245    def build_columns(self, x: np.ndarray, is_training: bool = False) -> np.ndarray:
246        return np.asarray(x[:, self.feature], dtype=float).ravel().reshape(-1, 1)
247
248    def build_penalties(self) -> List[np.ndarray]:
249        return []
250
251
252def instantiate_mgcv_terms(configs: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> List[_MgcvTerm]:
253    """Instantiate mgcv term objects from parsed formula config dicts."""
254    terms: List[_MgcvTerm] = []
255    for cfg in configs:
256        kind = cfg["type"]
257        feats = cfg["features"]
258        kw = dict(cfg["kwargs"])
259
260        # Map pyGAM/mgcv parameter aliases
261        k_val = kw.pop("k", None)
262        if k_val is None:
263            k_val = kw.pop("n_splines", 10)
264
265        sp_val = kw.pop("sp", None)
266        if sp_val is None:
267            sp_val = kw.pop("lam", None)
268
269        bs_val = kw.pop("bs", "tp")
270        m_val = kw.pop("m", None)
271        knots_val = kw.pop("knots", None)
272        constraint_val = kw.pop("constraint", None)
273
274        if kind == "s":
275            terms.append(
276                _MgcvSplineTerm(
277                    feature=feats[0],
278                    k=k_val,
279                    bs=bs_val,
280                    sp=sp_val,
281                    m=m_val,
282                    knots=knots_val,
283                    constraint=constraint_val,
284                )
285            )
286        elif kind == "te":
287            te_k = k_val if isinstance(k_val, (int, list)) else 5
288            terms.append(
289                _MgcvTensorTerm(
290                    features=feats,
291                    k=te_k,
292                    bs=bs_val,
293                    sp=sp_val,
294                )
295            )
296        elif kind == "f":
297            coding = kw.pop("coding", "dummy")
298            terms.append(_MgcvFactorTerm(feature=feats[0], coding=coding))
299        elif kind == "l":
300            terms.append(_MgcvLinearTerm(feature=feats[0]))
301        else:
302            raise ValueError(f"Unknown term type '{kind}' in formula.")
303
304    return terms

lingam.mgcv._lingam¶

Single-term penalised GAM — LinGAM class (mgcv backend).

class lingam.mgcv._lingam.LinGAM(n_splines: int = 10, lam: float | None = None, spline_order: int = 3, constraint: str | None = None, k: int | None = None, sp: float | None = None, bs: str = 'tp', method: str = 'REML', gamma: float = 1.0)[source]¶

Penalised GAM for a single smooth term y = beta_0 + f(x) + eps (mgcv backend).

Compatible with both pyGAM and R mgcv conventions.

Parameters:

  • n_splines (int, default 10) – Number of basis functions (basis dimension k in mgcv).

  • k (int, optional) – Alias for n_splines (mgcv convention). If provided, overrides n_splines.

  • lam (float, optional, default None) – Smoothing parameter (sp in mgcv). If None (default), estimated automatically via REML (or GCV). If a float >= 0 is provided, smoothing is fixed to that value.

  • sp (float, optional) – Alias for lam (mgcv convention). If provided, overrides lam.

  • bs (str, default 'tp') – Basis type: - ‘tp’: Thin plate regression splines (mgcv default) - ‘ts’: Thin plate regression splines with shrinkage - ‘cr’: Cubic regression splines (natural boundary conditions) - ‘cs’: Cubic regression splines with shrinkage - ‘cc’: Cyclic cubic regression splines - ‘ps’: P-splines (discrete difference penalties) - ‘cp’: Cyclic P-splines - ‘bs’: B-splines with integrated derivative penalties - ‘re’: Random effect / ridge penalty

  • method (str, default 'REML') – Smoothing parameter estimation criterion: ‘REML’ (mgcv default) or ‘GCV.Cp’.

  • gamma (float, default 1.0) – Multiplier for degrees of freedom in GCV criterion.

  • spline_order (int, default 3) – Degree of polynomial (used for ‘ps’ and ‘bs’).

  • constraint (str or None, default None) – Optional shape constraint. Supports None or ‘periodic’ (sets bs=’cc’).

property n_coefs: int¶

Effective number of model coefficients (smooth + intercept).

property is_fitted: bool¶

  1"""Single-term penalised GAM — LinGAM class (mgcv backend)."""
  2
  3from __future__ import annotations
  4
  5from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Union
  6
  7import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
  8import numpy as np
  9from numpy.typing import ArrayLike
 10from scipy import stats
 11
 12from ._optimizer import fit_mgcv_engine
 13from ._smooths import (
 14    absorb_sum_to_zero_constraint,
 15    build_smooth_basis,
 16    predict_smooth_basis,
 17    rescale_penalty,
 18)

 20
 21class LinGAM:
 22    """Penalised GAM for a single smooth term y = beta_0 + f(x) + eps (mgcv backend).
 23
 24    Compatible with both pyGAM and R mgcv conventions.
 25
 26    Parameters
 27    ----------
 28    n_splines : int, default 10
 29        Number of basis functions (basis dimension k in mgcv).
 30    k : int, optional
 31        Alias for n_splines (mgcv convention). If provided, overrides n_splines.
 32    lam : float, optional, default None
 33        Smoothing parameter (sp in mgcv). If None (default), estimated
 34        automatically via REML (or GCV). If a float >= 0 is provided,
 35        smoothing is fixed to that value.
 36    sp : float, optional
 37        Alias for lam (mgcv convention). If provided, overrides lam.
 38    bs : str, default 'tp'
 39        Basis type:
 40        - 'tp': Thin plate regression splines (mgcv default)
 41        - 'ts': Thin plate regression splines with shrinkage
 42        - 'cr': Cubic regression splines (natural boundary conditions)
 43        - 'cs': Cubic regression splines with shrinkage
 44        - 'cc': Cyclic cubic regression splines
 45        - 'ps': P-splines (discrete difference penalties)
 46        - 'cp': Cyclic P-splines
 47        - 'bs': B-splines with integrated derivative penalties
 48        - 're': Random effect / ridge penalty
 49    method : str, default 'REML'
 50        Smoothing parameter estimation criterion: 'REML' (mgcv default)
 51        or 'GCV.Cp'.
 52    gamma : float, default 1.0
 53        Multiplier for degrees of freedom in GCV criterion.
 54    spline_order : int, default 3
 55        Degree of polynomial (used for 'ps' and 'bs').
 56    constraint : str or None, default None
 57        Optional shape constraint. Supports None or 'periodic' (sets bs='cc').
 58    """
 59
 60    def __init__(
 61        self,
 62        n_splines: int = 10,
 63        lam: Optional[float] = None,
 64        spline_order: int = 3,
 65        constraint: Optional[str] = None,
 66        k: Optional[int] = None,
 67        sp: Optional[float] = None,
 68        bs: str = "tp",
 69        method: str = "REML",
 70        gamma: float = 1.0,
 71    ) -> None:
 72        if k is not None:
 73            n_splines = int(k)
 74        if sp is not None:
 75            lam = float(sp)
 76
 77        if constraint == "periodic":
 78            bs = "cc"
 79        elif constraint is not None:
 80            raise ValueError(
 81                f"Unsupported constraint '{constraint}' for mgcv backend. "
 82                "mgcv natively supports 'periodic' (bs='cc'). For soft shape "
 83                "constraints (monotonicity, convexity), use backend='pygam'."
 84            )
 85
 86        if n_splines < 3:
 87            raise ValueError("n_splines (k) must be at least 3.")
 88        if lam is not None and lam < 0:
 89            raise ValueError("Smoothing parameter 'lam' / 'sp' must be non-negative.")
 90
 91        self.n_splines = int(n_splines)
 92        self.k = self.n_splines
 93        self.lam = float(lam) if lam is not None else None
 94        self.sp = self.lam
 95        self.spline_order = int(spline_order)
 96        self.constraint = constraint
 97        self.bs = bs.lower()
 98        self.method = method.upper()
 99        self.gamma = float(gamma)
100
101        self.edge_knots_: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
102        self.knots_: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
103        self.coef_: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
104        self.design_matrix_: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
105        self.statistics_: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
106        self._B_solve: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
107
108        self._meta: Dict[str, Any] = {}
109        self._Z: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
110        self._S_abs: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
111
112    @property
113    def n_coefs(self) -> int:
114        """Effective number of model coefficients (smooth + intercept)."""
115        if self.coef_ is not None:
116            return len(self.coef_)
117        return self.n_splines
118
119    @property
120    def is_fitted(self) -> bool:
121        return self.coef_ is not None
122
123    def _check_is_fitted(self) -> None:
124        if not self.is_fitted:
125            raise RuntimeError(
126                "This LinGAM instance is not fitted yet. "
127                "Call 'fit' or 'gridsearch' first."
128            )
129
130    def __repr__(self) -> str:
131        status = "fitted" if self.is_fitted else "unfitted"
132        sp_str = f"sp={self.lam:.4g}" if self.lam is not None else "sp=auto"
133        cons_str = f", constraint='{self.constraint}'" if self.constraint else ""
134        return (
135            f"LinGAM(k={self.n_splines}, bs='{self.bs}', {sp_str}, "
136            f"method='{self.method}'{cons_str}) [{status}]"
137        )
138
139    # ── design & penalty ─────────────────────────────────────────
140
141    def _compile_basis(self, x: np.ndarray, n_splines: Optional[int] = None) -> None:
142        k_val = n_splines if n_splines is not None else self.n_splines
143        m_param: Any = None
144        if self.bs in ("ps", "cp", "bs", "b"):
145            m_param = (self.spline_order - 1, 2)
146        X_raw, S_list, meta = build_smooth_basis(x, bs=self.bs, k=k_val, m=m_param)
147        S_scaled, _ = rescale_penalty(X_raw, S_list)
148        _, S_abs_list, Z = absorb_sum_to_zero_constraint(X_raw, S_scaled)
149        self._meta = meta
150        self._Z = Z
151        self._S_abs = S_abs_list[0] if S_abs_list else np.zeros((Z.shape[1], Z.shape[1]))
152
153    def _build_design_matrix(
154        self,
155        x: np.ndarray,
156        n_splines: Optional[int] = None,
157    ) -> np.ndarray:
158        if self._Z is None or n_splines is not None:
159            self._compile_basis(x, n_splines=n_splines)
160        X_raw = predict_smooth_basis(x, self._meta)
161        X_smooth = X_raw @ self._Z
162        # Model matrix: [X_smooth, 1]
163        return np.hstack([X_smooth, np.ones((len(x), 1))])
164
165    def _build_penalty(self) -> np.ndarray:
166        k_smooth = self._Z.shape[1]
167        m = k_smooth + 1
168        P = np.zeros((m, m), dtype=float)
169        P[:k_smooth, :k_smooth] = self._S_abs
170        return P
171
172    # ── fit ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
173
174    def fit(self, x: ArrayLike, y: ArrayLike) -> "LinGAM":
175        """Fit the GAM model using mgcv REML or GCV criteria.
176
177        Parameters
178        ----------
179        x : array-like of shape (n_samples,)
180            Training feature.
181        y : array-like of shape (n_samples,)
182            Target values.
183        """
184        x_arr = np.asarray(x, dtype=float).ravel()
185        y_arr = np.asarray(y, dtype=float).ravel()
186        if not np.all(np.isfinite(x_arr)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(y_arr)):
187            raise ValueError("Input data contains NaN or infinity.")
188
189        self.edge_knots_ = np.array([float(np.min(x_arr)), float(np.max(x_arr))])
190        self._compile_basis(x_arr)
191        X = self._build_design_matrix(x_arr)
192        self.design_matrix_ = X
193        P = self._build_penalty()
194
195        k_smooth = self._Z.shape[1]
196        sp_fixed = [self.lam] if self.lam is not None else [None]
197
198        fit_res = fit_mgcv_engine(
199            X=X,
200            y=y_arr,
201            S_list=[P],
202            sp_fixed=sp_fixed,
203            method=self.method,
204            gamma=self.gamma,
205            coef_slices=[(0, k_smooth)],
206            M_p=1,
207        )
208
209        self.coef_ = fit_res["coef"]
210        self.lam = float(fit_res["sp"][0])
211        self.sp = self.lam
212        self._B_solve = fit_res["H_inv"] @ X.T
213
214        # Store knots metadata
215        xp = self._meta.get("xp")
216        if xp is None:
217            xp = self._meta.get("knots")
218        if xp is None:
219            xp = self._meta.get("Xu")
220        self.knots_ = np.asarray(xp) if xp is not None else np.linspace(self.edge_knots_[0], self.edge_knots_[1], self.n_splines)
221
222        self.statistics_ = {
223            "edof": fit_res["edof"],
224            "edof_per_coef": fit_res["edof_per_coef"],
225            "scale": fit_res["scale"],
226            "cov": fit_res["Vp"],
227            "Vp": fit_res["Vp"],
228            "Ve": fit_res["Ve"],
229            "se": fit_res["se"],
230            "rss": fit_res["rss"],
231            "deviance": fit_res["deviance"],
232            "null_deviance": fit_res["null_deviance"],
233            "deviance_explained": fit_res["deviance_explained"],
234            "r_sq_adj": fit_res["r_sq_adj"],
235            "n_samples": fit_res["n_samples"],
236            "GCV": fit_res["GCV"],
237            "score": fit_res["score"],
238            "method": fit_res["method"],
239            "sp": fit_res["sp"],
240            "f_stat_per_term": fit_res["f_stat_per_term"],
241            "p_values_per_term": fit_res["p_values_per_term"],
242            "edf_per_term": fit_res["edf_per_term"],
243        }
244        return self
245
246    # ── grid search ──────────────────────────────────────────────
247
248    def gridsearch(
249        self,
250        x: ArrayLike,
251        y: ArrayLike,
252        n_splines: Optional[ArrayLike] = None,
253        lam: Optional[ArrayLike] = None,
254        gamma: float = 1.0,
255    ) -> "LinGAM":
256        """Select optimal basis dimension k (and optionally lam) via REML or GCV.
257
258        In mgcv, smoothing parameter lambda is estimated automatically for each
259        basis dimension k.
260
261        Parameters
262        ----------
263        x, y : array-like
264            Training data.
265        n_splines : array-like of int, optional
266            Candidate basis dimensions. Default: np.arange(5, 25, 2).
267        lam : array-like of float, optional
268            If provided, tests combinations of fixed lam.
269        gamma : float, default 1.0
270            Degrees-of-freedom multiplier.
271        """
272        x_arr = np.asarray(x, dtype=float).ravel()
273        y_arr = np.asarray(y, dtype=float).ravel()
274        self.edge_knots_ = np.array([float(np.min(x_arr)), float(np.max(x_arr))])
275
276        if n_splines is None:
277            n_splines = np.arange(5, 25, 2)
278        n_splines_list = [int(v) for v in np.atleast_1d(n_splines)]
279
280        best_score = np.inf
281        best_k = self.n_splines
282        best_lam = self.lam
283
284        if lam is None:
285            # Auto-estimate lambda for each candidate basis dimension k
286            for k_cand in n_splines_list:
287                cand_model = LinGAM(
288                    n_splines=k_cand,
289                    lam=None,
290                    bs=self.bs,
291                    method=self.method,
292                    gamma=gamma,
293                    spline_order=self.spline_order,
294                )
295                try:
296                    cand_model.fit(x_arr, y_arr)
297                    score = cand_model.statistics_["score"]
298                    if score < best_score:
299                        best_score = score
300                        best_k = k_cand
301                        best_lam = cand_model.lam
302                except Exception:
303                    continue
304        else:
305            lam_list = [float(v) for v in np.atleast_1d(lam)]
306            for k_cand in n_splines_list:
307                for l_cand in lam_list:
308                    cand_model = LinGAM(
309                        n_splines=k_cand,
310                        lam=l_cand,
311                        bs=self.bs,
312                        method=self.method,
313                        gamma=gamma,
314                        spline_order=self.spline_order,
315                    )
316                    try:
317                        cand_model.fit(x_arr, y_arr)
318                        score = cand_model.statistics_["score"]
319                        if score < best_score:
320                            best_score = score
321                            best_k = k_cand
322                            best_lam = l_cand
323                    except Exception:
324                        continue
325
326        self.n_splines = best_k
327        self.k = best_k
328        self.lam = best_lam
329        self.sp = best_lam
330        self.fit(x_arr, y_arr)
331        return self
332
333    # ── predict ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
334
335    def predict(self, x: ArrayLike) -> np.ndarray:
336        """Predict target values for new data points x."""
337        self._check_is_fitted()
338        x_arr = np.asarray(x, dtype=float).ravel()
339        X = self._build_design_matrix(x_arr)
340        return X @ self.coef_
341
342    # ── intervals ────────────────────────────────────────────────
343
344    def confidence_intervals(self, x: ArrayLike, width: float = 0.95) -> np.ndarray:
345        """Compute Bayesian confidence intervals for the linear predictor."""
346        return self._compute_intervals(x, width, prediction=False)
347
348    def prediction_intervals(self, x: ArrayLike, width: float = 0.95) -> np.ndarray:
349        """Compute prediction intervals for new observations."""
350        return self._compute_intervals(x, width, prediction=True)
351
352    def _compute_intervals(self, x: ArrayLike, width: float, prediction: bool) -> np.ndarray:
353        self._check_is_fitted()
354        x_arr = np.asarray(x, dtype=float).ravel()
355        X = self._build_design_matrix(x_arr)
356
357        lp = X @ self.coef_
358        cov = self.statistics_["cov"]
359        var = np.sum((X @ cov) * X, axis=1)
360
361        if prediction:
362            var += self.statistics_["scale"]
363
364        alpha = (1.0 - width) / 2.0
365        df = max(self.statistics_["n_samples"] - self.statistics_["edof"], 1.0)
366        q_lo = stats.t.ppf(alpha, df=df)
367        q_hi = stats.t.ppf(1.0 - alpha, df=df)
368
369        se = np.sqrt(np.maximum(var, 1e-14))
370        return np.column_stack([lp + q_lo * se, lp + q_hi * se])
371
372    # ── statistics ────────────────────────────────────────────────
373
374    def loglikelihood(self) -> float:
375        """Gaussian log-likelihood of fitted model."""
376        self._check_is_fitted()
377        n = self.statistics_["n_samples"]
378        rss = self.statistics_["rss"]
379        scale = self.statistics_["scale"]
380        return -0.5 * n * np.log(2.0 * np.pi * scale) - 0.5 * rss / scale
381
382    def aic(self) -> float:
383        """Akaike Information Criterion (AIC)."""
384        self._check_is_fitted()
385        return -2.0 * self.loglikelihood() + 2.0 * (self.statistics_["edof"] + 1)
386
387    def bic(self) -> float:
388        """Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC)."""
389        self._check_is_fitted()
390        n = self.statistics_["n_samples"]
391        k = self.statistics_["edof"] + 1
392        return -2.0 * self.loglikelihood() + np.log(n) * k
393
394    def deviance_explained(self) -> float:
395        """Fraction of null deviance explained (pseudo R-squared)."""
396        self._check_is_fitted()
397        return self.statistics_["deviance_explained"]
398
399    # ── summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
400
401    def summary(self) -> str:
402        """Return formatted summary matching R mgcv's summary.gam output."""
403        self._check_is_fitted()
404        n = self.statistics_["n_samples"]
405        k_smooth = self._Z.shape[1]
406        beta_0 = self.coef_[-1]
407        se_0 = self.statistics_["se"][-1]
408        t_val = beta_0 / max(se_0, 1e-12)
409        p_val = 2.0 * (1.0 - stats.t.cdf(np.abs(t_val), df=max(n - self.statistics_["edof"], 1)))
410
411        term_edf = self.statistics_["edf_per_term"][0] if self.statistics_["edf_per_term"] else self.statistics_["edof"] - 1.0
412        f_stat = self.statistics_["f_stat_per_term"][0] if self.statistics_["f_stat_per_term"] else 0.0
413        term_pval = self.statistics_["p_values_per_term"][0] if self.statistics_["p_values_per_term"] else 1.0
414
415        score_name = "REML" if self.method == "REML" else "GCV"
416        score_val = self.statistics_["score"]
417
418        lines = [
419            "",
420            "Family: gaussian ",
421            "Link function: identity ",
422            "",
423            f"Formula: y ~ s(x, bs='{self.bs}', k={self.n_splines})",
424            "",
425            "Parametric coefficients:",
426            f"            Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)",
427            f"(Intercept) {beta_0:10.4f} {se_0:10.4f} {t_val:7.3f} {p_val:8.4g}",
428            "",
429            "Approximate significance of smooth terms:",
430            f"        edf Ref.df      F p-value",
431            f"s(x) {term_edf:6.2f} {self.n_splines - 1:6d} {f_stat:6.3f} {term_pval:8.4g}",
432            "",
433            f"R-sq.(adj) = {self.statistics_['r_sq_adj']:.4f}   Deviance explained = {self.statistics_['deviance_explained'] * 100:.1f}%",
434            f"{score_name} = {score_val:10.4f}  Scale est. = {self.statistics_['scale']:.4f}   n = {n}",
435            "",
436        ]
437        out_str = "\n".join(lines)
438        return out_str
439
440    # ── plotting ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
441
442    def plot_decomposition(
443        self,
444        x: ArrayLike,
445        y: ArrayLike,
446        n_grid: int = 300,
447        figsize: Tuple[int, int] = (16, 5),
448    ) -> Tuple["plt.Figure", np.ndarray]:
449        """Plot basis decomposition, coefficients, and overall fit."""
450        self._check_is_fitted()
451        x_arr = np.asarray(x, dtype=float).ravel()
452        y_arr = np.asarray(y, dtype=float).ravel()
453        k_smooth = self._Z.shape[1]
454
455        x_grid = np.linspace(np.min(x_arr), np.max(x_arr), n_grid)
456        X_grid = self._build_design_matrix(x_grid)
457        B_grid = X_grid[:, :k_smooth]
458        y_pred = X_grid @ self.coef_
459
460        fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=figsize)
461
462        # 1. Basis functions
463        ax1 = axes[0]
464        cmap = plt.get_cmap("tab20" if k_smooth <= 20 else "hsv")
465        colors = [cmap(i % 20 if k_smooth <= 20 else i / k_smooth) for i in range(k_smooth)]
466        for j in range(k_smooth):
467            ax1.plot(x_grid, B_grid[:, j], color=colors[j], alpha=0.8, label=f"b_{j}")
468        ax1.set(xlabel="x", ylabel="B_j(x)", title=f"Basis Functions (dim={k_smooth})")
469        if k_smooth <= 12:
470            ax1.legend(fontsize=7, loc="upper right")
471
472        # 2. Coefficients
473        ax2 = axes[1]
474        vals = np.append(self.coef_[:k_smooth], self.coef_[-1])
475        labels = [f"b_{j}" for j in range(k_smooth)] + ["intercept"]
476        ax2.bar(range(len(vals)), vals, color=colors + ["dimgray"])
477        ax2.set_xticks(range(len(vals)))
478        ax2.set_xticklabels(labels, rotation=45, ha="right", fontsize=7)
479        ax2.axhline(0, color="k")
480        ax2.set(ylabel="Coefficient value", title="Estimated Coefficients")
481
482        # 3. Fit and data
483        ax3 = axes[2]
484        ax3.scatter(x_arr, y_arr, alpha=0.5, color="gray", s=12, label="Data")
485        ax3.plot(x_grid, y_pred, "k-", lw=2, label="GAM fit")
486        ax3.set(xlabel="x", ylabel="y", title="Overall Model Fit")
487        ax3.legend(fontsize=7, loc="upper left")
488
489        fig.suptitle(
490            f"LinGAM Decomposition (k={self.n_splines}, bs='{self.bs}', sp={self.lam:.4f}, method={self.method})"
491        )
492        return fig, axes
493
494    def plot_diagnostics(
495        self,
496        x: ArrayLike,
497        y: ArrayLike,
498        figsize: Tuple[int, int] = (10, 9),
499    ) -> Tuple["plt.Figure", np.ndarray]:
500        """Diagnostic plots for model validation."""
501        self._check_is_fitted()
502        x_arr = np.asarray(x, dtype=float).ravel()
503        y_arr = np.asarray(y, dtype=float).ravel()
504
505        y_fit = self.predict(x_arr)
506        residuals = y_arr - y_fit
507        r2 = self.deviance_explained()
508
509        fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=figsize)
510        axes = axes.ravel()
511
512        # 1. Observed vs Fitted
513        ax = axes[0]
514        ax.scatter(y_fit, y_arr, alpha=0.5, edgecolors="k", s=20)
515        lims = [min(y_arr.min(), y_fit.min()), max(y_arr.max(), y_fit.max())]
516        ax.plot(lims, lims, "r--", lw=1.5, label="1:1")
517        ax.set(xlabel="Fitted values", ylabel="Observed values", title=f"Observed vs Fitted (R²={r2:.3f})")
518        ax.legend()
519
520        # 2. Residuals vs Fitted
521        ax = axes[1]
522        ax.scatter(y_fit, residuals, alpha=0.5, edgecolors="k", s=20)
523        ax.axhline(0, color="r", linestyle="--", lw=1.5)
524        ax.set(xlabel="Fitted values", ylabel="Residuals", title="Residuals vs Fitted")
525
526        # 3. Normal Q-Q
527        ax = axes[2]
528        stats.probplot(residuals, dist="norm", plot=ax)
529        ax.set_title("Normal Q-Q")
530        ax.get_lines()[0].set_markerfacecolor("steelblue")
531        ax.get_lines()[0].set_markeredgecolor("k")
532        ax.get_lines()[0].set_alpha(0.6)
533        ax.get_lines()[1].set_color("r")
534
535        # 4. Residual density
536        ax = axes[3]
537        ax.hist(residuals, bins="auto", density=True, color="steelblue", edgecolor="k", alpha=0.7)
538        sigma = np.std(residuals, ddof=1)
539        x_norm = np.linspace(residuals.min(), residuals.max(), 200)
540        ax.plot(x_norm, stats.norm.pdf(x_norm, 0.0, sigma), "r-", lw=2, label="Normal approx.")
541        ax.set(xlabel="Residuals", ylabel="Density", title="Residual Distribution")
542        ax.legend()
543
544        fig.suptitle(
545            f"LinGAM Diagnostics (k={self.n_splines}, bs='{self.bs}', sp={self.lam:.4f})",
546            fontsize=12,
547            fontweight="bold",
548        )
549        fig.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.97])
550        return fig, axes

lingam.mgcv._gam¶

Multi-term GAM with formula interface and REML/GCV optimization (mgcv backend).

class lingam.mgcv._gam.GAMCore(formula: str, method: str = 'REML', gamma: float = 1.0, fit_intercept: bool = True, spline_order: int = 3)[source]¶

Multi-term Generalized Additive Model with formula interface (mgcv backend).

Parameters:

  • formula (str) –

    Model specification, e.g.:

    "s(0, bs='tp', k=10) + te(1, 2, bs='cr', k=5) + f(3) + l(4)"

    Also accepts pyGAM syntax:

    "s(0, n_splines=10) + te(1, 2) + f(3) + l(4)"

  • method (str, default 'REML') – Smoothing parameter estimation criterion: ‘REML’ (mgcv default) or ‘GCV.Cp’.

  • gamma (float, default 1.0) – Degrees of freedom penalty multiplier for GCV.

  • fit_intercept (bool, default True) – Whether to include an unpenalised intercept term.

  • spline_order (int, default 3) – Default polynomial degree for B-splines / P-splines.

  1"""Multi-term GAM with formula interface and REML/GCV optimization (mgcv backend)."""
  2
  3from __future__ import annotations
  4
  5from itertools import product as cartesian_product
  6from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Union
  7
  8import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
  9import numpy as np
 10from numpy.typing import ArrayLike
 11from scipy import stats
 12
 13from .._formula import parse_formula
 14from ._optimizer import fit_mgcv_engine
 15from ._terms import (
 16    _MgcvFactorTerm,
 17    _MgcvLinearTerm,
 18    _MgcvSplineTerm,
 19    _MgcvTensorTerm,
 20    _MgcvTerm,
 21    instantiate_mgcv_terms,
 22)
 23
 24
 25class GAMCore:
 26    """Multi-term Generalized Additive Model with formula interface (mgcv backend).
 27
 28    Parameters
 29    ----------
 30    formula : str
 31        Model specification, e.g.::
 32
 33            "s(0, bs='tp', k=10) + te(1, 2, bs='cr', k=5) + f(3) + l(4)"
 34
 35        Also accepts pyGAM syntax::
 36
 37            "s(0, n_splines=10) + te(1, 2) + f(3) + l(4)"
 38
 39    method : str, default 'REML'
 40        Smoothing parameter estimation criterion: 'REML' (mgcv default)
 41        or 'GCV.Cp'.
 42    gamma : float, default 1.0
 43        Degrees of freedom penalty multiplier for GCV.
 44    fit_intercept : bool, default True
 45        Whether to include an unpenalised intercept term.
 46    spline_order : int, default 3
 47        Default polynomial degree for B-splines / P-splines.
 48    """
 49
 50    def __init__(
 51        self,
 52        formula: str,
 53        method: str = "REML",
 54        gamma: float = 1.0,
 55        fit_intercept: bool = True,
 56        spline_order: int = 3,
 57    ) -> None:
 58        self.formula = formula
 59        self.method = method.upper()
 60        self.gamma = float(gamma)
 61        self.fit_intercept = bool(fit_intercept)
 62        self.spline_order = int(spline_order)
 63
 64        configs = parse_formula(formula)
 65        self._term_configs = configs
 66        self._terms: List[_MgcvTerm] = instantiate_mgcv_terms(configs)
 67
 68        self._coef_slices: List[Tuple[int, int]] = []
 69        self.coef_: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
 70        self.statistics_: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
 71        self._B_solve: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
 72        self._design_matrix_: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
 73
 74    @property
 75    def is_fitted(self) -> bool:
 76        return self.coef_ is not None
 77
 78    @property
 79    def n_terms(self) -> int:
 80        return len(self._terms)
 81
 82    def _check_fitted(self) -> None:
 83        if not self.is_fitted:
 84            raise RuntimeError("Model not fitted. Call fit() or gridsearch() first.")
 85
 86    def __repr__(self) -> str:
 87        status = "fitted" if self.is_fitted else "unfitted"
 88        return f"GAMCore(formula='{self.formula}', method='{self.method}') [{status}]"
 89
 90    def _compile(self, x: np.ndarray) -> None:
 91        for term in self._terms:
 92            term.compile(x)
 93
 94    def _build_model_matrix(self, x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
 95        blocks = [t.build_columns(x) for t in self._terms]
 96        if self.fit_intercept:
 97            blocks.append(np.ones((len(x), 1), dtype=float))
 98        return np.hstack(blocks)
 99
100    def _compute_coef_slices(self) -> None:
101        slices = []
102        offset = 0
103        for t in self._terms:
104            slices.append((offset, offset + t.n_coefs))
105            offset += t.n_coefs
106        self._coef_slices = slices
107
108    # ── fit ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
109
110    def fit(self, x: ArrayLike, y: ArrayLike) -> "GAMCore":
111        """Fit multi-term GAM model using REML or GCV criteria."""
112        x_arr = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
113        y_arr = np.asarray(y, dtype=float).ravel()
114        if not np.all(np.isfinite(x_arr)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(y_arr)):
115            raise ValueError("Input data contains NaN or infinity.")
116        if x_arr.ndim == 1:
117            x_arr = x_arr.reshape(-1, 1)
118
119        self._compile(x_arr)
120        self._compute_coef_slices()
121        X = self._build_model_matrix(x_arr)
122        self._design_matrix_ = X
123        n, p = X.shape
124
125        # Construct global penalty matrices for each term's penalties
126        S_list: List[np.ndarray] = []
127        sp_fixed: List[Optional[float]] = []
128
129        for i, term in enumerate(self._terms):
130            start, end = self._coef_slices[i]
131            pens = term.build_penalties()
132            term_sps = term.sp if term.sp is not None else [None] * len(pens)
133
134            for pen_idx, P_sub in enumerate(pens):
135                P_full = np.zeros((p, p), dtype=float)
136                P_full[start:end, start:end] = P_sub
137                S_list.append(P_full)
138                sp_fixed.append(term_sps[pen_idx] if pen_idx < len(term_sps) else None)
139
140        fit_res = fit_mgcv_engine(
141            X=X,
142            y=y_arr,
143            S_list=S_list,
144            sp_fixed=sp_fixed if any(sp is not None for sp in sp_fixed) else None,
145            method=self.method,
146            gamma=self.gamma,
147            coef_slices=self._coef_slices,
148            M_p=1 if self.fit_intercept else 0,
149        )
150
151        self.coef_ = fit_res["coef"]
152        self._B_solve = fit_res["H_inv"] @ X.T
153
154        # Update terms with estimated smoothing parameters
155        sp_idx = 0
156        for term in self._terms:
157            n_pens = len(term.build_penalties())
158            if n_pens > 0:
159                term.sp = fit_res["sp"][sp_idx : sp_idx + n_pens]
160                sp_idx += n_pens
161
162        self.statistics_ = {
163            "edof": fit_res["edof"],
164            "edof_per_coef": fit_res["edof_per_coef"],
165            "scale": fit_res["scale"],
166            "cov": fit_res["Vp"],
167            "Vp": fit_res["Vp"],
168            "Ve": fit_res["Ve"],
169            "se": fit_res["se"],
170            "rss": fit_res["rss"],
171            "deviance": fit_res["deviance"],
172            "null_deviance": fit_res["null_deviance"],
173            "deviance_explained": fit_res["deviance_explained"],
174            "r_sq_adj": fit_res["r_sq_adj"],
175            "n_samples": fit_res["n_samples"],
176            "GCV": fit_res["GCV"],
177            "score": fit_res["score"],
178            "method": fit_res["method"],
179            "sp": fit_res["sp"],
180            "edf_per_term": fit_res["edf_per_term"],
181            "f_stat_per_term": fit_res["f_stat_per_term"],
182            "p_values_per_term": fit_res["p_values_per_term"],
183        }
184        return self
185
186    # ── predict / partial dependence ──────────────────────────────
187
188    def predict(self, x: ArrayLike) -> np.ndarray:
189        """Predict values for new feature data x."""
190        self._check_fitted()
191        x_arr = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
192        if x_arr.ndim == 1:
193            x_arr = x_arr.reshape(-1, 1)
194        X = self._build_model_matrix(x_arr)
195        return X @ self.coef_
196
197    def partial_dependence(self, term_idx: int, x: ArrayLike) -> np.ndarray:
198        """Evaluate the partial contribution of term term_idx."""
199        self._check_fitted()
200        if term_idx < 0 or term_idx >= len(self._terms):
201            raise IndexError(f"term_idx {term_idx} out of range (0..{len(self._terms) - 1}).")
202        x_arr = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
203        if x_arr.ndim == 1:
204            x_arr = x_arr.reshape(-1, 1)
205        B_term = self._terms[term_idx].build_columns(x_arr)
206        start, end = self._coef_slices[term_idx]
207        return B_term @ self.coef_[start:end]
208
209    # ── intervals ────────────────────────────────────────────────
210
211    def confidence_intervals(self, x: ArrayLike, width: float = 0.95) -> np.ndarray:
212        """Compute Bayesian confidence intervals for the linear predictor."""
213        return self._compute_intervals(x, width, prediction=False)
214
215    def prediction_intervals(self, x: ArrayLike, width: float = 0.95) -> np.ndarray:
216        """Compute prediction intervals for new observations."""
217        return self._compute_intervals(x, width, prediction=True)
218
219    def _compute_intervals(self, x: ArrayLike, width: float, prediction: bool) -> np.ndarray:
220        self._check_fitted()
221        x_arr = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
222        if x_arr.ndim == 1:
223            x_arr = x_arr.reshape(-1, 1)
224        X = self._build_model_matrix(x_arr)
225        lp = X @ self.coef_
226
227        cov = self.statistics_["cov"]
228        var = np.sum((X @ cov) * X, axis=1)
229        if prediction:
230            var += self.statistics_["scale"]
231
232        alpha = (1.0 - width) / 2.0
233        df = max(self.statistics_["n_samples"] - self.statistics_["edof"], 1.0)
234        q_lo = stats.t.ppf(alpha, df=df)
235        q_hi = stats.t.ppf(1.0 - alpha, df=df)
236
237        se = np.sqrt(np.maximum(var, 1e-14))
238        return np.column_stack([lp + q_lo * se, lp + q_hi * se])
239
240    # ── statistics ────────────────────────────────────────────────
241
242    def loglikelihood(self) -> float:
243        """Gaussian log-likelihood of fitted model."""
244        self._check_fitted()
245        n = self.statistics_["n_samples"]
246        rss = self.statistics_["rss"]
247        scale = self.statistics_["scale"]
248        return -0.5 * n * np.log(2.0 * np.pi * scale) - 0.5 * rss / scale
249
250    def aic(self) -> float:
251        """Akaike Information Criterion (AIC)."""
252        self._check_fitted()
253        return -2.0 * self.loglikelihood() + 2.0 * (self.statistics_["edof"] + 1)
254
255    def bic(self) -> float:
256        """Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC)."""
257        self._check_fitted()
258        n = self.statistics_["n_samples"]
259        k = self.statistics_["edof"] + 1
260        return -2.0 * self.loglikelihood() + np.log(n) * k
261
262    def deviance_explained(self) -> float:
263        """Fraction of null deviance explained (pseudo R-squared)."""
264        self._check_fitted()
265        return self.statistics_["deviance_explained"]
266
267    # ── grid search ──────────────────────────────────────────────
268
269    def gridsearch(
270        self,
271        x: ArrayLike,
272        y: ArrayLike,
273        n_splines_grids: Optional[List[ArrayLike]] = None,
274        gamma: float = 1.0,
275    ) -> "GAMCore":
276        """Search over candidate basis dimensions k for smooth terms via REML/GCV.
277
278        Parameters
279        ----------
280        x, y : array-like
281            Training data.
282        n_splines_grids : list of array-like, optional
283            Candidate basis dimension arrays for smooth terms.
284        gamma : float, default 1.0
285            Degrees-of-freedom multiplier.
286        """
287        x_arr = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
288        y_arr = np.asarray(y, dtype=float).ravel()
289        if x_arr.ndim == 1:
290            x_arr = x_arr.reshape(-1, 1)
291
292        # Collect smooth terms that can vary k
293        smooth_indices = [
294            i for i, t in enumerate(self._terms) if isinstance(t, (_MgcvSplineTerm, _MgcvTensorTerm))
295        ]
296
297        if not smooth_indices or n_splines_grids is None:
298            # Just fit with current settings
299            return self.fit(x_arr, y_arr)
300
301        all_combos = list(cartesian_product(*n_splines_grids))
302        best_score = np.inf
303        best_combo = None
304
305        for combo in all_combos:
306            # Create term configs with new k values
307            configs_copy = [dict(cfg) for cfg in self._term_configs]
308            for idx_in_smooth, term_i in enumerate(smooth_indices):
309                cfg = configs_copy[term_i]
310                cfg["kwargs"] = dict(cfg.get("kwargs", {}))
311                cfg["kwargs"]["k"] = combo[idx_in_smooth]
312
313            terms_cand = instantiate_mgcv_terms(configs_copy)
314            cand_model = GAMCore(
315                formula=self.formula,
316                method=self.method,
317                gamma=gamma,
318                fit_intercept=self.fit_intercept,
319                spline_order=self.spline_order,
320            )
321            cand_model._terms = terms_cand
322            cand_model._term_configs = configs_copy
323            try:
324                cand_model.fit(x_arr, y_arr)
325                score = cand_model.statistics_["score"]
326                if score < best_score:
327                    best_score = score
328                    best_combo = combo
329            except Exception:
330                continue
331
332        if best_combo is not None:
333            for idx_in_smooth, term_i in enumerate(smooth_indices):
334                cfg = self._term_configs[term_i]
335                cfg["kwargs"] = dict(cfg.get("kwargs", {}))
336                cfg["kwargs"]["k"] = best_combo[idx_in_smooth]
337            self._terms = instantiate_mgcv_terms(self._term_configs)
338
339        return self.fit(x_arr, y_arr)
340
341    # ── summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
342
343    def summary(self) -> str:
344        """Formatted summary table matching R mgcv's summary.gam."""
345        self._check_fitted()
346        n = self.statistics_["n_samples"]
347        score_name = "REML" if self.method == "REML" else "GCV"
348        score_val = self.statistics_["score"]
349
350        lines = [
351            "",
352            "Family: gaussian ",
353            "Link function: identity ",
354            "",
355            f"Formula: {self.formula}",
356            "",
357        ]
358
359        # Parametric coefficients: Intercept + linear terms
360        param_rows = []
361        df_res = max(n - self.statistics_["edof"], 1.0)
362        if self.fit_intercept:
363            b0 = self.coef_[-1]
364            se0 = self.statistics_["se"][-1]
365            t0 = b0 / max(se0, 1e-12)
366            p0 = 2.0 * (1.0 - stats.t.cdf(np.abs(t0), df=df_res))
367            param_rows.append(("(Intercept)", b0, se0, t0, p0))
368
369        for i, t in enumerate(self._terms):
370            if isinstance(t, _MgcvLinearTerm):
371                start, _ = self._coef_slices[i]
372                b = self.coef_[start]
373                se_b = self.statistics_["se"][start]
374                tb = b / max(se_b, 1e-12)
375                pb = 2.0 * (1.0 - stats.t.cdf(np.abs(tb), df=df_res))
376                param_rows.append((f"l({t.feature})", b, se_b, tb, pb))
377
378        if param_rows:
379            lines.append("Parametric coefficients:")
380            lines.append("            Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)")
381            for name, b, se_b, tb, pb in param_rows:
382                lines.append(f"{name:11s} {b:10.4f} {se_b:10.4f} {tb:7.3f} {pb:8.4g}")
383            lines.append("")
384
385        # Smooth terms
386        smooth_rows = []
387        for i, t in enumerate(self._terms):
388            if isinstance(t, (_MgcvSplineTerm, _MgcvTensorTerm)):
389                if isinstance(t, _MgcvSplineTerm):
390                    label = f"s({t.feature})"
391                    ref_df = t.k - 1
392                else:
393                    feats_str = ",".join(str(f) for f in t.features)
394                    label = f"te({feats_str})"
395                    ref_df = t.n_coefs
396
397                edf = self.statistics_["edf_per_term"][i]
398                f_stat = self.statistics_["f_stat_per_term"][i]
399                pval = self.statistics_["p_values_per_term"][i]
400                smooth_rows.append((label, edf, ref_df, f_stat, pval))
401
402        if smooth_rows:
403            lines.append("Approximate significance of smooth terms:")
404            lines.append("        edf Ref.df      F p-value")
405            for label, edf, ref_df, f_stat, pval in smooth_rows:
406                lines.append(f"{label:7s} {edf:6.2f} {ref_df:6d} {f_stat:6.3f} {pval:8.4g}")
407            lines.append("")
408
409        lines.extend([
410            f"R-sq.(adj) = {self.statistics_['r_sq_adj']:.4f}   Deviance explained = {self.statistics_['deviance_explained'] * 100:.1f}%",
411            f"{score_name} = {score_val:10.4f}  Scale est. = {self.statistics_['scale']:.4f}   n = {n}",
412            "",
413        ])
414        return "\n".join(lines)
415
416    # ── plotting ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
417
418    def plot_decomposition(
419        self,
420        x: ArrayLike,
421        y: ArrayLike,
422        n_grid: int = 200,
423        figsize: Optional[Tuple[int, int]] = None,
424        feature_names: Optional[List[str]] = None,
425    ) -> Tuple["plt.Figure", np.ndarray]:
426        """Plot partial dependence for all terms in the GAM."""
427        self._check_fitted()
428        x_arr = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
429        y_arr = np.asarray(y, dtype=float).ravel()
430        if x_arr.ndim == 1:
431            x_arr = x_arr.reshape(-1, 1)
432
433        def _fname(idx: int) -> str:
434            if feature_names is not None and idx < len(feature_names):
435                return feature_names[idx]
436            return f"x[{idx}]"
437
438        p_predictors = x_arr.shape[1]
439        n_terms = len(self._terms)
440        n_term_cols = min(3, n_terms)
441        n_term_rows = int(np.ceil(n_terms / n_term_cols)) if n_terms > 0 else 0
442        n_rows = 1 + n_term_rows
443        n_cols = max(n_term_cols, 1)
444
445        if figsize is None:
446            figsize = (n_cols * 5, n_rows * 4)
447
448        fig = plt.figure(figsize=figsize)
449        gs = fig.add_gridspec(n_rows, n_cols, hspace=0.4, wspace=0.35)
450
451        feat_mins = np.min(x_arr, axis=0)
452        feat_maxs = np.max(x_arr, axis=0)
453        medians = np.median(x_arr, axis=0)
454
455        # 1. Overall fit
456        ax_overall = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :])
457        grid0 = np.linspace(feat_mins[0], feat_maxs[0], n_grid)
458        x_overall = np.tile(medians, (n_grid, 1))
459        x_overall[:, 0] = grid0
460        y_overall = self.predict(x_overall)
461        sort_idx = np.argsort(grid0)
462
463        ax_overall.plot(grid0[sort_idx], y_overall[sort_idx], "C0-", lw=2, label="GAM fit")
464        ax_overall.scatter(x_arr[:, 0], y_arr, alpha=0.4, color="gray", s=10, label="Data")
465        ax_overall.set(xlabel=_fname(0) if p_predictors > 1 else "x", ylabel="y")
466        ax_overall.set_title(
467            f"GAM Fit (Score={self.statistics_['score']:.3f}, EDF={self.statistics_['edof']:.1f}, n={self.statistics_['n_samples']})"
468        )
469        ax_overall.legend(fontsize=7, loc="best")
470
471        # 2. Individual terms
472        for i, term in enumerate(self._terms):
473            row = 1 + i // n_term_cols
474            col = i % n_term_cols
475            ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[row, col])
476
477            if isinstance(term, _MgcvSplineTerm):
478                x_sweep = np.tile(medians, (n_grid, 1))
479                g_feat = np.linspace(feat_mins[term.feature], feat_maxs[term.feature], n_grid)
480                x_sweep[:, term.feature] = g_feat
481                pdep = self.partial_dependence(i, x_sweep)
482                sp_val = term.sp[0] if term.sp else 0.0
483                ax.plot(g_feat, pdep, "C1-", lw=2, label=f"s({term.feature})")
484                ax.axhline(0, color="gray", ls="--", lw=0.5)
485                ax.set(xlabel=_fname(term.feature), ylabel="Contribution")
486                ax.set_title(f"s({term.feature})  k={term.k}, sp={sp_val:.3g}")
487                ax.legend(fontsize=7)
488
489            elif isinstance(term, _MgcvTensorTerm):
490                if term.d == 2:
491                    ng2d = min(n_grid, 60)
492                    g0 = np.linspace(feat_mins[term.features[0]], feat_maxs[term.features[0]], ng2d)
493                    g1 = np.linspace(feat_mins[term.features[1]], feat_maxs[term.features[1]], ng2d)
494                    f0, f1 = np.meshgrid(g0, g1, indexing="ij")
495                    x_2d = np.tile(medians, (ng2d * ng2d, 1))
496                    x_2d[:, term.features[0]] = f0.ravel()
497                    x_2d[:, term.features[1]] = f1.ravel()
498                    pdep = self.partial_dependence(i, x_2d).reshape(ng2d, ng2d)
499                    im = ax.pcolormesh(f0, f1, pdep, shading="auto", cmap="RdBu_r")
500                    plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, label="Contribution")
501                    ax.set(xlabel=_fname(term.features[0]), ylabel=_fname(term.features[1]))
502                    feats_str = ",".join(str(f) for f in term.features)
503                    ax.set_title(f"te({feats_str})")
504            elif isinstance(term, _MgcvLinearTerm):
505                x_sweep = np.tile(medians, (n_grid, 1))
506                g_feat = np.linspace(feat_mins[term.feature], feat_maxs[term.feature], n_grid)
507                x_sweep[:, term.feature] = g_feat
508                pdep = self.partial_dependence(i, x_sweep)
509                b = self.coef_[self._coef_slices[i][0]]
510                ax.plot(g_feat, pdep, "C4-", lw=2)
511                ax.axhline(0, color="gray", ls="--", lw=0.5)
512                ax.set(xlabel=_fname(term.feature), ylabel="Contribution", title=f"l({term.feature}) beta={b:.4f}")
513            elif isinstance(term, _MgcvFactorTerm):
514                col_vals = np.asarray(x_arr[:, term.feature]).ravel()
515                unique_lvls = np.unique(col_vals)
516                contribs = []
517                for lvl in unique_lvls:
518                    x_lvl = medians.copy().reshape(1, -1)
519                    x_lvl[0, term.feature] = lvl
520                    contribs.append(self.partial_dependence(i, x_lvl)[0])
521                colors = ["C2" if v >= 0 else "C3" for v in contribs]
522                ax.bar(range(len(contribs)), contribs, color=colors, edgecolor="k", lw=0.5)
523                ax.axhline(0, color="gray", ls="-", lw=0.5)
524                ax.set_xticks(range(len(contribs)))
525                ax.set_xticklabels(unique_lvls, fontsize=8)
526                ax.set(ylabel="Contribution", title=f"f({term.feature})")
527
528        fig.suptitle(f"GAMCore Decomposition — {self.formula}", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold")
529        return fig, np.array(fig.axes)
530
531    def plot_diagnostics(
532        self,
533        x: ArrayLike,
534        y: ArrayLike,
535        figsize: Optional[Tuple[int, int]] = None,
536    ) -> Tuple["plt.Figure", np.ndarray]:
537        """Diagnostic plots for model validation."""
538        self._check_fitted()
539        x_arr = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
540        y_arr = np.asarray(y, dtype=float).ravel()
541        if x_arr.ndim == 1:
542            x_arr = x_arr.reshape(-1, 1)
543
544        y_fit = self.predict(x_arr)
545        residuals = y_arr - y_fit
546        r2 = self.deviance_explained()
547
548        figsize = figsize or (10, 9)
549        fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=figsize)
550        axes = axes.ravel()
551
552        # 1. Observed vs Fitted
553        ax = axes[0]
554        ax.scatter(y_fit, y_arr, alpha=0.5, edgecolors="k", s=20)
555        lims = [min(y_arr.min(), y_fit.min()), max(y_arr.max(), y_fit.max())]
556        ax.plot(lims, lims, "r--", lw=1.5, label="1:1")
557        ax.set(xlabel="Fitted values", ylabel="Observed values", title=f"Observed vs Fitted (R²={r2:.3f})")
558        ax.legend()
559
560        # 2. Residuals vs Fitted
561        ax = axes[1]
562        ax.scatter(y_fit, residuals, alpha=0.5, edgecolors="k", s=20)
563        ax.axhline(0, color="r", linestyle="--", lw=1.5)
564        ax.set(xlabel="Fitted values", ylabel="Residuals", title="Residuals vs Fitted")
565
566        # 3. Normal Q-Q
567        ax = axes[2]
568        stats.probplot(residuals, dist="norm", plot=ax)
569        ax.set_title("Normal Q-Q")
570        ax.get_lines()[0].set_markerfacecolor("steelblue")
571        ax.get_lines()[0].set_markeredgecolor("k")
572        ax.get_lines()[0].set_alpha(0.6)
573        ax.get_lines()[1].set_color("r")
574
575        # 4. Residual density
576        ax = axes[3]
577        ax.hist(residuals, bins="auto", density=True, color="steelblue", edgecolor="k", alpha=0.7)
578        sigma = np.std(residuals, ddof=1)
579        x_norm = np.linspace(residuals.min(), residuals.max(), 200)
580        ax.plot(x_norm, stats.norm.pdf(x_norm, 0.0, sigma), "r-", lw=2, label="Normal approx.")
581        ax.set(xlabel="Residuals", ylabel="Density", title="Residual Distribution")
582        ax.legend()
583
584        fig.suptitle(f"GAMCore Diagnostics — {self.formula}", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold")
585        fig.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.97])
586        return fig, axes
